chunks: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer; indeed, Allah is with the patient.

key_terms.الصَّابِرِينَ: The patient ones, those who persevere
key_terms.الصَّبْرِ: Patience, perseverance, or fortitude in the face of hardship or duty
key_terms.وَالصَّلَاةِ: And prayer, specifically the ritual salat

ai.seo_question: How should Muslims seek help in their affairs according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing a dual mechanism for spiritual resilience: internal steadfastness (sabr) and external connection with the Divine (salah). The promise 'Allah is with the patient' is understood not merely as presence, but as divine support and victory, a concept deeply linked to the trials of the Ahl al-Bayt and the concept of sabr in the face of adversity.
